description: c-saves: Rust-native world storage engine for Paper 26.3. CRS2 container: custom section codec (dense bit-packed palettes + delta-varint heightmaps), per-key field split for entity/POI payloads with interned keys and key-redundant Position stripping, content-addressed section dedup, slab-packed small blobs, id/varint recipes, versioned shared zstd dictionaries, hot/cold two-tier compression (L12 write / L19 background), transparent Moonrise chunk-IO takeover, Anvil import/export. 8-9x smaller than vanilla regions.
